infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ForestWatch uses your location to find nearby plantations and to send GPS with monitoring, reports, and inspections. Distance is calculated on the server.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ForestWatch uses the camera to attach field photographs to monitoring updates, reports, and inspections.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ForestWatch can attach an existing photograph to a field update.
